checklist.text: A night recording: crickets or insects, an owl now and then, very few birds
Same layout as the day set: forest_night_bed.ogg plus forest_night_N.wav one-shots in resources/sounds/ambience/
Crossfade day and night beds through dusk and dawn (Ambience.cs now fades the day bed out with WorldClock Darkness; the night bed would fade in as it falls)
Decide: dawn and dusk bird bouts (a bed of their own), and whether rain gets its own forest sound

description: Night version of the forest ambience (5.18 is daytime only; at night the Hologram View is silent apart from the hum). Needs a night recording from you; the code side is small. Reuses the stereo bed + random one-shots layout.
title: Forest ambience at night
